SELECT COUNT(*) AS TotalVirtualSchools
FROM schools AS s
INNER JOIN satscores AS ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE ss.AvgScrMath > 400 AND s.Virtual = 'F';

SELECT MAX(frm.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`) AS max_free_rate
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
JOIN frpm frm ON s.CDSCode = frm.CDSCode
WHERE (ss.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / ss.NumTstTakr) > 0.3;
